Candidate assumptions MA-D01 and MA-D02 require C review; details: docs/12.
MA-D01: one invocation per attempt; FAILED/BLOCKED do not restart this object.
MA-D02: UNKNOWN has no active query; an inconclusive lookup returns to UNKNOWN.
MA-Q01: attempt_count meaning remains open; this diagram assigns no increment rule.
MA-Q02: cross-approval recovery remains open; no automatic new effect or fingerprint reuse.
State labels retain rc.3 OperationAttempt.status in local rc.4; only SUCCEEDED has an OperationResult payload.
Domain alone persists local state/results/audit; method labels are internal effects, not new APIs.
A failed save leaves the last durable state; recovery queries the same attempt before any retry.
Unknown effects never become terminal merely because recovery stops or the case is handled manually.
recordManualRecoveryNeed does not reopen or escalate an already accepted rejection/manual outcome.
Notification events do not change this lifecycle; successful effects are never replayed.
All attempt records and audit history are retained; a final node does not delete them.
